description: This file provides cryptographic utility functions for generating private keys, self-signed certificates, and writing keys/certificates to files using the WolfSSL library. It includes command-line interface handling for key and certificate creation.

methods.name: int write_file(byte * buf,int bufSz,char * path,bool cert)
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a specified file or stderr if filename is null, handling file opening, writing, and synchronization.

methods.name: int write_key(ecc_key * ecKey,RsaKey * rsaKey,int type,int keySz,char * fName,bool write_pem)
methods.description: Converts an ECC or RSA key to DER format, optionally encodes to PEM, and writes it to a file.

methods.name: int gen_key(WC_RNG * rng,ecc_key * ecKey,RsaKey * rsaKey,int type,int keySz,long exp,int curve)
methods.description: Generates an ECC or RSA key pair based on specified parameters.

methods.name: int selfsigned(WC_RNG * rng,char ** arg)
methods.description: Generates a self-signed certificate along with a key pair based on command-line arguments, and saves it to specified files.

methods.name: int dokey(WC_RNG * rng,int type,char ** arg)
methods.description: Generates a key (ECC or RSA) based on command line parameters and writes it to a file.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Main entry point for command-line utility, dispatching to key or certificate generation functions.

ctags.name: gen_key
ctags.pattern: /^int gen_key(WC_RNG *rng, ecc_key *ecKey, RsaKey *rsaKey, int type, int keySz,$/
ctags.signature: (WC_RNG * rng,ecc_key * ecKey,RsaKey * rsaKey,int type,int keySz,long exp,int curve)

ctags.name: write_file
ctags.pattern: /^int write_file(byte *buf, int bufSz, char *path, bool cert) {$/

ctags.name: write_key
ctags.pattern: /^int write_key(ecc_key *ecKey, RsaKey *rsaKey, int type, int keySz, char *fName,$/
ctags.signature: (ecc_key * ecKey,RsaKey * rsaKey,int type,int keySz,char * fName,bool write_pem)
